definitions.explanation: The way something is; the state or condition of a thing or place. Often used when describing a scene or situation that the speaker has witnessed.
Used with a negative nuance to describe a deplorable or unsightly condition. Often preceded by この or その.

examples.japanese: ⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ありさま⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The state of the town changed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被災地|ひさいち}→被災地：27434_hisaichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ありさま⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I saw the state of the disaster area on TV.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦後|せんご}→戦後：12853_sengo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ありさま⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記録|きろく}した→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧⟦{写真集|しゃしんしゅう}→写真集：19947_shashinshuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出版|しゅっぱん}→出版：03222_shuppan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A photo book documenting the state of postwar Japan was published.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧ありさま⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧だ。
⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{散|ち}らかった→散らかる：04357_chirakaru⟧ありさま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: I was shocked at the messy state of the room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大敗|たいはい}→大敗：08201_taihai⟧し、⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{当|あ}てられない→当てる：01864_ateru⟧ありさまだった。
examples.english: They suffered a crushing defeat — it was a pitiful sight.

notes:
Written in kanji as {有様|ありさま} or {有|あ}り{様|さま}, but often written in hiragana. Describes the visible condition or state of something, typically something the speaker has observed directly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ありさま: the state of a town
- ⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ありさま: the state of the scene
- ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧ありさま: this (sorry) state of affairs
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{当|あ}てられない→当てる：01864_ateru⟧ありさま: a sight too awful to look at
- ありさま⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧: to convey the situation

USAGE:
In sense 1, ありさま is neutral and simply refers to the observable state of something. In sense 2, especially with ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧ or ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧, it carries a strong negative connotation — disappointment, disgust, or dismay at the way things look.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: condition — more objective and technical
- ⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧: appearance, look — broader and more neutral
- ざま: a harsh, contemptuous variant meaning "pitiful sight"
